report: Read all five verses end to end against the 12 candidate lemmas and the four `added` units; found no construction analysed two ways without the ASV licensing the difference.

הַ: bare 'the' (125.3 ×3, 125.2 none written) vs. 'They that' / 'those that' / 'such as' (125.1, 125.4, 125.5) follows what the ASV wrote for each article under rules 15, 29 and 41; the rectum article of 'A Song of Ascents' is correctly unrepresented under rule 29's last sentence.

צַדִּיק 'of righteous' vs. 'righteous' is rectum vs. subject; סָבִיב 'are/is round about' differs only in copula number; עַל 'upon' vs. 'be upon' is adjunct vs. prepositional predicate (rule 49); עוֹלָם 'ever'/'evermore' and לְ 'for' (125.1) vs. unrepresented after סָבִיב (125.2, rule 40's own example) are all source-licensed.
125.2 מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם follows rule 26's own division verbatim (From this time forth / and / for / evermore). 125.1 'for ever' and 125.2 'for evermore' are both split under rule 2, consistently.
Supplied English: 'which' and 'but' (125.1), 'As' (125.2) and 'as for' (125.5) are each correctly `added` under rules 14, 16, 46 and 55; no verse folds a comparable word into a neighbouring morpheme.

125.5's two hedged placements ('unto' with the hiphil under rule 44 vs. with the noun under rule 33; 'forth' kept with הוֹלִיךְ vs. added) name their competing readings in their notes; without MACULA's clause role for עֲקַלְקַלּוֹתָם there is no ground to overturn either, and neither is a cross-verse matter.

BSB disagreements (5): the two לְ after סָבִיב and the two paragogic he (Sh) are documented convention differences (rules 40, 32); the 125.2 suffix הּ is the unrendered resumptive occurrence beside the once-written name (rule 22), with the competing reading recorded in the unit note. None is an error.
The one repeated note ('Rectum takes of, rule 19') restates the contract and needs no convention. Nothing here generalises beyond rules the contract already holds; no promotions or amendments.
